meta.title: Interest in politics
meta.question: How interested are Poles in politics?
meta.measure: Average interest in politics, from 0 (none) to 10 (very great)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on interest in politics, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How would you describe your interest in politics? It is: very great (I follow almost everything closely), great, average (only the main events), slight, none (it practically does not interest me)
items.notes: CBOS, Mar 1990 - Dec 2017, 318 surveys (the 'metryczka'). Some files add code 6 'would describe it differently' or 'other', which is no position. labels.csv truncates code 5 in 2008-17; checked in the files: all 318 pass.

items.wording: How interested would you say you are in politics: very, somewhat, not very, not at all interested?
items.notes: EVS 1990, 1999 (optional item o17, asked in Poland; code 1 misspelt 'very interessed'), 2008, 2017.

items.wording: To what extent are you interested in politics: to a very great extent, great, average, small, not at all
items.notes: PGSS 1992-2010, 10 waves.

items.wording: How interested are you in politics / extent of interest in politics: very high ... not at all (5 points)
items.notes: POLPAN 1993, 1998, 2003, 2008, 2013, 2018 (6 waves; not 1988). English labels change from 'how interested' (1993: extremely ... not at all; 1998: very interested ... not interested) to 'extent of interest' (2003-18: very high ... not at all); probably one Polish question, so one item (check the Polish questionnaires). Ageing panel with refreshment samples.

items.wording: How interested would you say you are in politics: very, somewhat, not very, not at all interested?
Interest in politics: very great (follow almost everything), great, average (only main events), slight, none (CBOS wording)
items.notes: PGSW 1997, 2001, 2005, 2007, 2011 (not 2015); CBOS wording. polint_w2 (2005 wave II, same respondents) left out.

items.wording: Interest in politics: very high, high, average, low, none (CBOS wording; 6 'would describe it differently' is no position)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study only; CBOS wording.

items.wording: How interested would you say you are in politics: very, quite, hardly, not at all interested?
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023). Round 10 self-completion (MODE_SPLITS).

items.wording: To what extent would you say you are interested in politics: very, somewhat, a little, not at all?
items.notes: EES 2004, 2009, 2019 (3 surveys). EES 2014 (ZA5160, a Eurobarometer) has only an agree/disagree statement ('You are very interested in politics'), which the regex excludes.

items.wording: How interested are you in politics: very, rather, rather not, not at all interested?
items.notes: PGSW 2019 and 2023.

items.wording: As CBOS_POLINT_5 (CBOS wording), online
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker wave 8 (2020) only; CBOS wording.

items.wording: Are you interested in politics, and how much? (1 not at all, I have other interests ... 4 very, I try to follow everything)
items.notes: SWPS omnibus 2020 only; coded 1 = not at all. labels.csv truncates code 4; checked in the file.

items.wording: Interest in politics: very, fairly, not very, not at all interested
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker wave 9 (2020) only.

items.wording: As CBOS_POLINT_5, in the CBOS democracy survey
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey (Apr 2021, mixed mode).

items.wording: How would you describe your interest in politics? It is: very great (I follow almost everything closely), great, average (only the main events), slight, none (it practically does not interest me)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: How interested would you say you are in politics: very, quite, hardly, not at all interested?
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: How interested are you in politics? (1 very little interested ... 7 very interested)
items.notes: NCN Opus panel wave 1 (2023) only (polint1_1; F1 in the merged file). labels.csv has no labels for NCN, but the .rds/.sav files do (label 'Jak bardzo jesteś zainteresowany(-a) polityką?...', codes '1. Bardzo mało zainteresowany(a)' ... '7. Bardzo zainteresowany(a)').

items.wording: To what extent would you say you are interested in politics: very, quite, not very, not at all?
items.notes: EES 2024 only.

items.wording: As FNW_POLINT4_ONLINE, coded the other way (1 = not at all interested)
items.notes: FNW SWPS May 2025 only (codes 1 = not at all ... 4 = very).

items.wording: As PGSW_POLINT_5 (code 6 'would describe it differently' is no position)
items.notes: PGSW 2025 only.

items.wording: How would you describe your interest in politics? Are you very, rather, rather not, not at all interested? (coded 1 = very)
items.notes: FNW SWPS Dec 2025 and May 2026. May 2025 codes the same question the other way round: see FNW_POLINT4R_ONLINE (same regex; the label check sends each wave to the right one). The two could be one item if the pipeline allowed a per-wave pole.

items.wording: How much does politics interest you: very, rather, rather not, not at all?
items.notes: BDCS survey, Poland (online, Dec 2025), only. Its 'PolInt' is an English recode of the same answers and is not matched.
